technical_requirements: Latency SLO: median end-to-end routing decision <= 30ms; p95 <= 70ms during peak bursts
Throughput: sustained 250 requests/sec average per region; bursts to 1.5k req/sec for 45-90s windows
Model preference: prefer trimmed Llama-2 style open variants with stable KV cache behavior; willing to test 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants
Batching: dynamic batching with per-region adaptive batch sizes; prefer suggestions from Redwood Optimize for batch size vs tail-latency tradeoff
Caching: prefix/KV cache for session affinities (driver conversation state) and route fragment reuse; eviction policy needs to be tunable
Quantization: need benchmarked accuracy delta for 4-bit quant vs fp16 on our prompt templates
Benchmarking: request Redwood-produced perf harness (load drivers + synthetic route graphs), and script for latency histograms, token-level cost, and p95/p99 tail analysis
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to lower-capacity cheaper variant during capacity pressure; require consistent output formatting for downstream microservices
